summary: WhatsApp design case c-addbiz-n (family 4, Workshop ewatrade/assistant/conversations scenes/wa/1-onboarding.json): an already-linked sender can create a new business under the same EwaTrade account from chat, behind ASSISTANT_WHATSAPP_ADD_BUSINESS_ENABLED=1 (default unset keeps today's ADD BUSINESS app pointer). Deterministic onboarding handler, never model input: one grouped message collects the facts the app's createBusinessSchema requires (name, country · currency short list, street address, city; store phone defaults to this WhatsApp number and is shown), then a review with Create business / Edit / Cancel. Create sends an email code to the linked account's email (implementation standard: email proof before business creation); a valid code for the same linked user runs createAssistantWhatsAppOnboardingBusiness, which rechecks the onboarding lease, fresh non-QA proof session and linked identity and then calls the canonical createOwnerBusiness (age, QA and retail-ops entitlement checks unchanged; idempotent per operation). The receipt offers Switch to it (canonical connectAssistantWhatsAppOnboarding grant + selection within the fresh-proof window) or Stay here (no grant; CONNECT later). Stale signed taps reply 'That choice expired. Nothing was changed.' Local only; no provider, OTP, env or deployment change.
noAssistantImpact: Identity/onboarding channel handler only. No assistant tool, prompt, capability declaration or model-driven write is added; business creation reuses createOwnerBusiness and the switch reuses the existing link authority unchanged.

evidence.result: 9 pass: entry phrases, grouped/labeled/short-list collection, flag off keeps the app pointer, review → Create → email proof → create → Switch, Stay grants nothing, Cancel/Edit never create, Create before review or after expiry does nothing, account mismatch, rejected create.
12 pass (with a placeholder EWATRADE_DATABASE_URL; no connection is made), including flag OFF free text stays with the assistant and a stale Create tap after a correction expires without effect.
Existing connection and registration dialogue unchanged; with whatsapp-registration-flow.test.ts all pass.

Not run: no database integration test for createAssistantWhatsAppOnboardingBusiness; QA_ACCESS_ACCEPTANCE_DATABASE_HOST is not configured here. Lease, fresh-session, identity and idempotency checks are unproven against a database.
